messages:
maria: heads-up: scheduling a midnight UTC maintenance for EU edge backplane firmware + NIC soft-restarts. Window 00:45-01:30 UTC. goal: avoid user-facing disruption but need coordinated drains and warmbackfill.
cheng: is this a partial rack reboot or just NIC/fw restart? impact on routing?
sam: plan: cordon->graceful drain -> NIC fw restart -> soft reboot of host processes -> kv warmseed. We'll stagger across 6 racks (every other rack) to maintain capacity.
anita: which pools exactly? will Dedicated reserved pools be affected? we should loop in account managers.
maria: affected pools: saturn-eu-core and saturn-eu-edge. Dedicated customers on those racks will be drained to local standby pools; we'll apply maintenance credits if we see any SLA blips.
leo: suggest canary on two low-traffic racks first (rack-11 + rack-19). If metrics stable for 20m proceed. Also set routing bias to avoid long-tail sequencing hitting fallback.
maria: canary = rack-11/rack-19. roll will wait 20 minutes after canary stabilization.
ops-bot: Created scheduled maintenance ticket: MAINT-2026-110-EU. Customer notif queued for enterprise-notify.
infra-oncall: I'll cover the window. I'll watch p90/p99 gen latency, packet drop, and NIC error counters.
cheng: preflight checklist (I'll validate in staging tonight):
- kv preseed: redctl kv seed --pool=saturn-eu --count=2500
- temporarily increase batching latency allowance for canary routes to 70ms
- add fallback: eu-east as secondary for non-pinned tenants
- rollback: if p95 >= 1.4x baseline or net drops > 0.3% abort and reinstate nodes
- customer comms: sales + infra-notify + support
sam: ops snippets (to run during procedure):
```
# cordon + drain
redctl node cordon rack-11 --reason "backplane-fw"
redctl job drain --target rack-11 --grace 180
# warmseed KV
redctl kv preheat --pool saturn-eu --seed /var/kv/seeds/saturn-seed-feb.json
```
anita: quick cost check: draining to standby will spin up burst capacity. roughly how many extra GPU-hours?
cheng: rough calc: ~3.5 GPU-hours per rack for warmbackfill and shard redistribution. Egress for KV seeds ~200MB per rack. Budget ~0.4% nightly spend for eu.
leo: note about pinned models: some Dedicated tenants pin specific quantized variants. If we fallback cross-region and those variants aren’t available, responses could differ. We need an explicit pinned-tenant routing override that keeps them on local standby capacity or holds requests.
maria: agreed. we'll add a routing override: if tenant.meta.pin=true -> prefer local-standby; if not available, failfast with 503 to avoid silent model changes. ops: approve?
infra-oncall: enable extra trace sampling for model routes and tag metrics with maint.tag=eu-fw. set alert: eu.gen.p95 > 650ms -> pager.
ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled at 1810010200 for rolling restarts after canary. Will post job status updates.
sam: annotate canary metrics: maint.stage=canary rack=rack-11
cheng: i'll run a quick dry-run in staging tonight at 21:30 UTC to sanity-check kv preseed and drain scripts.
maria: comms plan: send customer-facing note to #customer-comm and #announcements 2h prior, reminder 15m prior. Anita will draft message - include fallback behavior and expected minimal impact.
anita: drafting now. will call out fallback region, pinned tenant behavior, and credit policy.
leo: if NIC error counters spike, abort and trigger BMC rollback for that host. keep BMC lease until 02:00 UTC.
infra-oncall: monitoring dashboards ready. I'll escalate to eng-sre if we hit packet drops or sustained latency.
maria: thanks team. Starting staging dry run at 21:30 UTC. Will report canary outcome here. :white_check_mark:
